question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Study of coins
solution:
The correct answer is **'Numismatics'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The one-word substitute for the words '**Study of coins'** is '**Numismatics'**. (मुद्राशास्त्र) 
 
• 'Numismatics' is the **academic discipline** involving collecting, researching, and studying "coins and currency".
 
 
• **Example**: *Through numismatics, we can trace the evolution of trade throughout history.​*
 
 
 
• Hence, the Study of Coins is called **'Numismatics'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Philately**: The Study of postage stamps and postal history. (डाक-टिकट संग्रहण)
 
• **Antiquary**: A person who studies the things of the past. (पुरावशेष)
 
• **Apothecary**: A person who prepared and sold medicines and drugs historically. (औषधि बनाने या बेचने वाला)
